raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Process Excellence leader with 12+ years driving quality assurance, continuous improvement, and business transformation across Global Capability Center (GCC) operations. Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, PMP, APMG Change Management Foundation, and Certified AI Solutions Architect. Member of Nielsen - GCC India Executive Business Excellence. Track record of leading end-to-end program management for newly transitioned teams, delivering $500K+ in savings, significant cycle-time reductions, and AI-enabled process automation.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Process Excellence
Lean Six Sigma (DMAIC/DMADV) • Kaizen • Value Stream Mapping (VSM) • SIPOC • Continuous Improvement (CI) • Business Process Re-Engineering (BPR) • Operational Excellence • Waste Reduction • 5S
Quality & Governance
Root Cause Analysis (RCA) • FMEA • CAPA • Statistical Process Control (SPC) • SOP Development • Quality Assurance • ISO 9001 Standards • KPI Development • Benchmarking
Delivery & PMO
Project & Program Management • PMO • Agile / Scrum • Waterfall • Roadmap Governance • Vendor Transition • Phase-Gate Reviews • Benefit Realization
Strategy & Leadership
Strategic Planning • Change Management • Stakeholder Engagement • Cross-Functional Team Leadership • Executive Reporting • Organizational Change • Talent Mentoring
Data & Automation
Data-Driven Decision Making • Process Automation • RPA • AI-Enabled Optimization • Power BI • Risk Assessment & Mitigation • Cost & Productivity Optimization • Cycle Time Reduction
SELECTED CAREER HIGHLIGHTS
Cycle-Time Reduction: Led a Lean DMAIC project for an FMCG client delivering cycle-time reduction of 2.5 hours and lifting process accuracy to 97.5%, freeing 2 FTEs and saving 36 hours per month — demonstrating measurable waste elimination and FTE productivity gains.
Automation & Defect Reduction: Implemented RPA-enabled PO-tracking and invoice-automation, reducing missed EDI purchase orders from 1,000 to 200 per month — a 80% defect reduction through data-driven process automation.
Process Re-Engineering: Re-engineered a complex PMO process through root cause analysis and bottleneck elimination, reducing end-to-end processing time by 20% and improving throughput.
Order-to-Cash (O2C) Efficiency: Implemented a new cash-application process in the Order-to-Cash (O2C) cycle that drove a 95.5% efficiency gain and significantly reduced unapplied cash — a direct impact on working capital.
Scale of Ownership: Directed a $1.2B portfolio with a 25+ FTE cross-functional team across North America, serving global clients including Unilever, GSK, and Sandvik.
TOOLS & METHODOLOGIES
Tools: SAP /ERP • Power BI • MS Project • JIRA / Atlassian • Minitab • Visio • Smartsheet • MS Excel (Advanced), High Radius Circle Methodologies: DMAIC • DMADV • VSM • SIPOC • FMEA • RCA • CAPA • SPC • 5S • Kaizen • Agile / Scrum • Waterfall • PDCA • BPMN
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Assistant Manager – Process Excellence | Nielsen | GCC India | Aug 2024 – Present
Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Simplification
Led the end-to-end P2P simplification program, facilitating cross-functional workshops across Sourcing & Contracting and ServiceNow ticket review to map processes, assess process capability, and eliminate non-value-added activities.
Spearheaded AI solution implementation across vendor review and vendor intake; designed and delivered an AI chatbot prototype automating vendor intake for purchases under $10K., aims to eliminate administrative bottlenecks, reducing onboarding time from 14–16 weeks to 1–4 weeks, while maintaining strict legal and financial compliance Capacity Planning – Gracenote Rich Media Improved capacity planning for a 200-member operation, defining KPIs and optimizing workflows in Zendesk.

Built performance dashboards and redesigned workflows, reducing ticket resolution time from 48 to 18 hours—a 62.5% improvement. AI Change Management
Drove change management for the organization’s 2026 AI impact roadmap, executing a phased AI implementation rollout.
Partnered with cross-functional teams to develop AI training programs and learning documentation adopted organization-wide. Lean Six Sigma Training & Mentoring
Launched a Lean Six Sigma awareness program as a certified Black Belt, driving adoption through communication plans, nomination, and feedback processes.
Trained and mentored 30 Yellow Belt candidates, delivering $500K in savings and 36 hours of process time reduction.
Team Lead – Quality Audit | Allstate IndiaFeb 2023 – Aug 2023
Developed rigorous project schedules factoring team capacity, skill sets, and dependencies—optimizing lead/lag times, removing resource bottlenecks, and improving throughput.
Established a quality assurance (QA) framework with phase-gate reviews and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) controls, ensuring deliverables met defined acceptance criteria and preventing downstream defects.
Engaged stakeholders at all levels to apply Voice of the Customer (VoC) insights, translating requirements into high-value deliverables; onboarded 30+ new hires with KPI-based training that accelerated time-to-proficiency.
Conducted root cause analysis (RCA) on quality escapes, implementing corrective actions that reduced repeat defects and improved process capability (Cpk).
Management Trainee – Lean Transformation | GenpactMar 2020 – Feb 2023
Led a 25+ FTE cross-functional team managing a $1.2B FMCG portfolio across North America, optimizing supply chain and inventory processes to sustain 95.5% monthly revenue delivery.
Spearheaded a Lean Six Sigma DMAIC initiative applying value stream mapping (VSM) and statistical process control (SPC) to reduce cycle time by 2.5 hours, improve accuracy to 97.5%, and eliminate waste equivalent to 36 FTE-hours/month.
• Deployed process automation for invoice generation via a PO-tracking system built with sales and
supply-chain teams, cutting missed EDI purchase orders from 1,000 to 200/month (80% defect reduction).
Re-engineered a complex PMO process using SIPOC analysis and bottleneck mapping, reducing end-to-end processing time by 20% and improving throughput.
Facilitated client discovery workshops to elicit requirements and Voice of the Customer (VoC) data; deployed a performance-tracking dashboard to target training interventions and lift team productivity.
Process Associate– Project Management Office (PMO) | CapgeminiJan 2017 – Nov 2019

Implemented a redesigned cash-application process using process mapping (SIPOC/VSM) and root cause analysis, delivering a 95.5% efficiency gain in the Order-to-Cash (O2C) cycle and significantly reducing unapplied cash.
Managed a portfolio of high-value clients, balancing customer experience with disciplined credit-risk mitigation and compliance controls across the O2C lifecycle.
Supported PMO governance—project reporting, KPI tracking, risk assessment & mitigation, and prioritization—across cross-functional delivery teams.
Senior Associate – Quality Assurance | AltisourceMar 2015 – Apr 2016
Drove SOP development, quality assurance standards, and process consistency improvements; delivered training and mentorship programs to standardize delivery across teams.
Risk Analyst (TRMS) | AmazonJul 2012 – Mar 2015
Performed transaction-risk data analysis and assessment using statistical tools to detect and mitigate fraud, protecting revenue and customer trust.
